podcast.body: Featured on the "Blue Album," this song contains a reference to Rivers Cuomo's little brother, James, concerning issues James was having with an insurance claim after a car crash. "For example, there's a reference in, My Name is Jonas about River's little brother, and that had to do with the time James was having issues with an insurance claim after a car crash."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Rivers Cuomo and Weezer - Alt-Rock's Nerd Heroes Part 1

podcast.body: This song is featured on Weezer's debut album, often called "the blue one," and represents an early example of the band's Geek Rock sensibilities. "Weezer from their debut album, which is the blue one, and my name is Jonas."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
